integrity: Proof and the explicitly reproduced finite checks are self-contained; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary de Bruijn necklaces of order at least three; exactly two deleted positions, rotation quotient only. Other alphabets, higher deletion counts, probabilities weighted by deletion masks, and reverse-equivalence are not established. The public source date belongs to an antecedent, not to this finding.
title: A universal two-deletion necklace-shadow law for binary de Bruijn cycles
